overall_reason: A share dialog for 'Launch brief' with one 'Copy link' action; the permission setting it exists to change does not read as a control.

score.reason: T-SIGNATURE is weak: 'Can view' is 10px plain text with no chevron or field, so the dialog's key setting looks like a label; T-BOLD-MOVE passes on the single dark button.

findings.evidence: 'Can view' is a 10px #444 span at the far right of 'Anyone with the link', with no chevron, border or field.
findings.before: Permission shown as plain small text
findings.after: Show the permission as a control (a select with a chevron) at body size
findings.why: The share task is 'who can do what'; when that setting does not look changeable, the dialog only half does its job.

strengths: One clear dark 'Copy link' button with a link icon carries the action.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent: no brand authority, audience or overrides were available, so the item was read as an Operate composition (CON-018).
T-RIVAL-NAME cap: the composition names no client, so every placeholder label holds under any rival; the cap at 5 was not applied and the test was used only to spot default copy.
T-IDEA-CARRIES: single composition, there is no second screen to carry the idea.
T-DELETE-PICTURE and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: no lead image and no marketing promise, except where a finding says so.
T-COVER-TEXT: no brand theme or motif to recognise.
